heroSummary: Osseo Area Schools began Tuesday, September 2, 2025, and the last student day was Friday, June 5, 2026. Conference release was October 16–17, Winter Break ran December 24–31, and Spring Break ran March 23–27. Planned asynchronous remote-learning days occurred January 16 and April 24.
calendarNotes: The official grades K-12 calendar begins September 2 and ends June 5. It lists 172 student contact days divided 58/58/56 across three trimesters. October 16-17, January 2, and March 20 are conference-release dates with no students. January 16 and April 24 are asynchronous remote-learning days rather than holidays. Mark-reporting dates on November 26, March 6, and June 8 sit outside regular student attendance. Winter Break is printed December 24-31, with students returning January 5 after the January 1 holiday and January 2 conference-release date. Spring Break is March 23-27, and March 27 is also labeled a district-closed spring holiday.

customSections.label: Winter Break Ends Before Students Return
customSections.content: The PDF prints Winter Break as December 24–31. January 1 is a district holiday, January 2 is a no-student conference-release day, and students return Monday, January 5. For childcare, the useful consecutive student-free window is December 24–January 2.

customSections.label: January 16 and April 24 Still Carry Student Work
customSections.content: Both dates are labeled student asynchronous remote days with licensed-staff instructional planning. They interrupt normal in-person attendance but should not be treated as vacations or district closures.

customSections.label: Three Terms, Three Different Transition Patterns
customSections.content: Trimester one ends November 25 and trimester two begins December 1 after mark reporting and district holidays. Trimester two ends March 5, followed by mark reporting March 6 and trimester three on March 9. The final term and student year both end June 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Osseo Area Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for grades K-12 was Tuesday, September 2, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Osseo Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF labels December 24–31 as Winter Break. January 1 was a holiday and January 2 a conference-release day, so students returned January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Osseo Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran March 23–27, 2026, and students returned Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student contact days were in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 172 contact days across three trimesters of 58, 58, and 56 days.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of Osseo schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day was Friday, June 5, 2026. High-school commencement followed June 7, and mark reporting was June 8.

sourceReviewDetails: The one-page grades K-12 PDF is marked as School Board approved May 21, 2024 and lists 172 student contact days.
Visual rendering confirmed the legend's distinct colors for no-student, conference, staff-development, mark-reporting, holiday, and remote dates.
The winter return was recorded separately because the printed break, holiday, conference-release date, and actual student return are four different labels.
The two asynchronous dates were not converted to holidays.
The official archive lists translated editions, but the user did not request those older extension URLs for this file.
